description: This file contains unit test cases for the GatewayAgentChannel component in the OpenClaw project. It tests the behavior of the `shouldDeliver` method for various channels and the initialization logic of the `GatewayAgentChannel` enum with raw string inputs.

classes.name: GatewayAgentChannelTests
classes.description: A struct containing unit tests for the GatewayAgentChannel functionality.

methods.name: should deliver blocks web chat
methods.description: Tests whether the webchat channel's `shouldDeliver` method returns false for both true and false inputs.

methods.name: should deliver allows last and provider channels
methods.description: Tests that certain channels (`last`, `whatsapp`, `telegram`, `googlechat`, `bluebubbles`) return true from `shouldDeliver(true)` and false from `shouldDeliver(false)`.

methods.name: init raw normalizes and falls back to last
methods.description: Tests the initializer of `GatewayAgentChannel` with various raw string inputs, ensuring correct normalization and fallback to `.last`.
